name: ZAG Fire Laboratory Logatec
zag_role: Fire resistance and reaction to fire testing
description: Opened in 2022 and staffed by around twenty five people. It carries out fire resistance and reaction to fire testing on construction products and assemblies, including large scale furnace tests that the older Gameljne facility could not accommodate.
history: ZAG opened its Fire Laboratory at Obrtna cona 35 in Logatec on 2 September 2022, describing it as the largest facility of its kind in this part of Europe. The building has 3,421.70 square metres of gross floor area and holds two large furnaces with an exhaust gas cleaning plant. Specimens can be tested from microscale up to 4 m by 8 m. The declared project cost was 9,227,065.78 euros excluding VAT, made up of 1,660,554.40 euros from the state budget through the ministry, 4,305,077.38 euros of ZAG funds, 2,896,586.00 euros of ERDF funds through InnoRenew and 364,848.00 euros from ARRS, with the total including equipment reported as close to 11 million euros. Fire resistance testing covers non load bearing walls, ceilings and suspended facades, load bearing walls, ceilings, roofs, beams, columns, balconies and stairs, fire and smoke doors and windows with their hardware, protective systems for concrete, steel and timber, ventilation ducts, fire dampers, cable systems and smoke and heat control systems.
